body:
INDEPENDENT TYPE-DISCIPLINE REVIEW OF EXACT 57af23b02084048f8cf88ad451cac3681601bef6: HOLD. Two blockers and one major. I read both new files, verified the exact parent 4b74813 is current main, the two-path diff is clean, searched every CellCoordinates use, and reconciled it against the accepted trace shape at post-01M16KFZHZAACFWXTM3XCQS6N6. The term-status scope guard is GOOD: minimal negative probe, same-context positive control, and a real mutation kill. No suppressors, casts, nulls, throws, partial production access, stringly ADT, or provisional term classifier found.

BLOCKER 1 - THE PUBLIC FUNCTION DOES NOT RECEIVE A CELL OR A MATCHED TRIPLE (trace.scala:65-74).

The accepted boundary was keyed by AlignRef.Cell and gated by AlignWire.matched before any span is returned. This function instead accepts three unrelated values:

  of(unit: RecallUnit, node: NodeSummary, breakdown: CostBreakdown)

CostBreakdown carries neither unit nor node identity. Therefore a caller can compute b from (unitB, nodeB) and call of(unitA, nodeA, b). The result publishes A spans/text and A source support with B mode and B reduction receipts. Every value is individually lawful; the joined claim is false. Calling the function total does not repair the missing relation - it is total over unconstrained triples, not total over one cell.

Lawful shape: accept cell: AlignRef.Cell plus HsmmResult, RecallGraph, and SourceView; first require AlignWire.matched(result, view.contentFingerprint, AlignWire.recallChecksum(recall)); then look up the exact unit/state/breakdown/node. The result must be Either[AlignError, CellCoordinates], because a caller can name a cell absent from the proved result.

BLOCKER 2 - THE TYPE CANNOT REPRESENT EXTERNAL CELLS AND ERASES THEIR IDENTITY (trace.scala:37-51).

AlignState.External has no anchor, while CellCoordinates requires node: SourceNodeRef and nonempty sourceSupport: SpanSet. It therefore cannot represent Association, Commentary, Intrusion, Unranked, etc. Worse, mode: Option[FidelityMode] discards which external state this was. External(Intrusion) and External(Unranked) collapse, exactly the accepted H1 failure. The doc says mode is absent for an external state, but of(unit, arbitraryNode, CostBreakdown.unreachable) already yields mode=None WITH a source node/support; exclusion is dropped too.

Carry the canonical cell: AlignRef.Cell (or at minimum its AlignState) and make sourceSupport Option[SpanSet], None only when state.anchor is None. Do not store node plus mode as a second encoding of AlignState.

MAJOR - THE GENERATED CASE-CLASS API BYPASSES ANY FUTURE CHECK (trace.scala:37).

CellCoordinates is a public case class. A caller can take a good c and call c.copy(node = other.ref, sourceSupport = other.support), or use generated apply/fromProduct, while retaining the old unit, mode, and receipts. That directly contradicts the doc claim that the join cannot drift. Follow the construction boundary already used by HsmmResult, NodeSummary, SpanSet, and other proof carriers: a final non-case class with private[align] construction and public reads, plus compile-negative apply/copy/fromProduct courts with a same-shape positive canary.

SHOULD-HAVE-CHANGED / MISSING DISCRIMINATORS:
- no mixed-unit/node/breakdown court;
- no foreign view/recall fingerprint court;
- no Source versus Distorted same-anchor court;
- no Intrusion versus Unranked court;
- no generated copy/fromProduct forgery court.

NON-BLOCKING FOLLOW-UP: excludedMembers flattens reductions.values, dropping the owning CostTerm and exposing Map iteration order. If retained, return term-tagged exclusions in CostTerm.values order; otherwise consumers cannot tell whether Chart or Structural excluded a member.

Verdict scope: static exact-SHA review; I did not rerun the already reported 215-test align gate. The failures are signature/type proofs and do not depend on runtime output. 57af23b should not merge. The coordinate idea is right, but the only public entrance must preserve the cell identity and matched-triple proof the existing HsmmResult already carries.
